newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn firm, Sept soy offers pulled.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn firm, Sept soy offers pulled.

text.p: FOB Gulf corn offers firmed for prompt loadings due to harvest delays on Wednesday while nearby soybean offers were pulled after a large Taiwan purchase due to uncertainty about pipeline supplies, grain brokers said.
Soybean shippers withdrew offers through early October loadings because continued rain delays in harvesting in parts of the Midwest may prevent supplies being available.
Wheat values were quietly steady, brokers said.
Taiwan's BSPA Group overnight bought 162,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans for Dec 26-Feb 23 Gulf loadings at 88.53 cents over CBOT Jan to 89.67 cents over CBOT March.
Taiwan's FGEP Group bought 54,000 tonnes of corn overnight for Dec 10-25 Gulf loading at 89 cents over CBOT December.
